description: Displayed between Millennium Park and the College of the Rockies. Taken on strength 2 June 1966 as RCAF 26187, renumbered 114187 in 1971, flown by 3 CFFTS at CFB Portage; later at ATESS Mountain View fitted with the tail of 114063. Struck off 23 August 2005, briefly at Norwood and Campbellford, Ontario before moving to Creston.
museum_name: Creston Millennium Park CT-114 Tutor, Creston
